rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a weather season or a period of the year associated with a particular activity.

example.english: It rains a lot this season.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwai3 zit3 seng4 jat6 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this shorter form in compounds such as 雨季 or 四季 and, especially, for a TV programme's episode group such as 第三季.

example.english: The third season of this show is really good.
example.traditional: 呢套劇第三季真係好睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 dai6 saam1 gwai3 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2
